Messages.Author: Mael
Messages.Body:
Here is a short scene
which should illustrate my point
Is this what you want?

(meth a)
I bleed you for three
Like a Panda that won't eat
Your demise draws near

(meth b)
I attempt to block
For with an On the Que Vive
My vamp is awake

(meth a)
Awake he may be
But I am lost in the crowds
Can you still block it?

(meth b)
Alas I am bled
Like a fool and his money
I can't keep my pool

(meth a)
It is not just three
For with this conditioning
instead it's for six

(meth b)
Now that I won't have
With deflection I say 'no'
you bleed him instead

(meth c)
I hate all of you
I needed that pool to live
Now I die next turn
